premises: Recrystallizing the soft FCC phase eliminates weak boundaries and reduces dislocation pile-ups at phase boundaries.
Semi-coherent FCC/B2 boundaries prevent dislocation penetration, reducing pile-ups in the hard phase and promoting work hardening in FCC.
Phase-selective recrystallization can fully release strain hardening capacity in eutectic HEAs.

The untreated material exhibits dislocation pile-ups near phase boundaries leading to microcracking and limited ductility.
